comparison_basis.coverage_policy: QQQ uses Yahoo third-party history from 2005-01-03; other assets without native data at the selected start remain in the long-bond sleeve until their native start
comparison_basis.contribution_timing: first available portfolio trading day of each calendar month, before that day's strategy orders
comparison_basis.return_method: time-weighted return; external monthly contributions excluded from annual return and drawdown
comparison_basis.confirmation_rule: 1 consecutive own trading day(s) below/above the configured band; execute on the next trading day
